method: LIVE_GSC per-URL check against the authenticated GSC Pages 'Indexed' bucket, for every Wave 1/2/3 treatment and control slug. Slugs already confirmed present in the complete DISCOVERED_NOT_INDEXED software list (bucketA, 136/136 exact) were not re-checked live (they cannot also be indexed).

wave1_indexation-recovery-20260926.startedRelativeTo: Oldest wave in this engagement -- most elapsed time since intervention.

wave2_indexation-factory-wave2-20260926.startedRelativeTo: Middle wave -- less elapsed time than Wave 1.

wave3_master-google-war-wave3-20260926.startedRelativeTo: Newest wave -- least elapsed time since intervention (this session's own predecessor phase).

criticalFinding: The treatment-vs-control indexation gap tracks wave AGE, not wave order or treatment intensity: Wave 1 (oldest) shows treatment clearly ahead of control (42.9% vs 20%); Wave 2 (middle) shows a smaller treatment lead (16.7% vs 7.7%); Wave 3 (newest, from this session's immediate predecessor phase) shows treatment BEHIND control (0% vs 30%) -- the opposite direction. This is exactly the caution Part 19/20 asks for: a page Google has not yet recrawled since a content change cannot be classified as a failed treatment. Wave 3's 0% is very plausibly a 'not yet recrawled' artifact, not evidence the treatment doesn't work -- but by the same logic, Wave 1's stronger showing is consistent with the pricing/cons treatment mechanism genuinely helping once Google has had enough time to act on it.
limitationNote: This session did not capture exact last-crawl-date per individual Wave 1/2/3 URL (that would require ~97 individual URL Inspections, roughly 30+ minutes of additional browser time). The classification into NOT_RECRAWLED_SINCE_CHANGE / RECRAWLED_STILL_EXCLUDED / INDEXED_AFTER_CHANGE that Part 20 asks for is therefore only possible at the wave-age level (this file), not the individual-URL level, this session. A future session with more time could do the full per-URL crawl-date capture for a much sharper answer.
conclusion: This is the first real, direct evidence in this entire engagement that the core pricing/cons treatment mechanism MAY be working -- but only visible once enough time has passed. Do not conclude the mechanism failed from Wave 3's 0% alone, and do not conclude it definitely works from Wave 1's 42.9% alone (n=14 and n=10 are both small). Recommend re-running this exact check again on Wave 2 and Wave 3 in another 2-4 weeks before drawing a firmer conclusion.
